title: Catch duplicate entities before they are accepted; add entities add/merge
description: MoM knowledge index has ~17 real duplicate pairs (NTSB, MCP, surnames beside full names). Build: (1) knowledge entities add --kind --name --alias --actor with standard disambiguation tagging, (2) knowledge entities merge --from --into --actor, (3) data-driven pre-accept duplicate check used by publish-run and the AI review accept path. Live cleanup is a documented procedure, not run here.
